title: OpenCode in SpecWithCode
labelsCheckedAt: SpecWithCode 0.2.6 (specweave-studio v0.2.6) with OpenCode 2.0.26, rendered and recorded 2026-10-11

stepVerbs.expect: text must be visible within 20 s (or timeout ms), else the take stops
stepVerbs.click: move the cursor to the element (role + name, or text), outline it, click
stepVerbs.clickIfPresent: click only when the element exists (optional steps)
stepVerbs.hover: move the cursor to the element and hold
stepVerbs.type: type text (into a placeholder or the focused element)
stepVerbs.waitTurn: wait until the agent turn ends (no Stop button); the edit speed-ramps this span
stepVerbs.ensureOption: open a combobox and pick an option only when it does not already show it

shots.vo: OpenCode in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.

card.title: OpenCode in SpecWithCode
card.subtitle: Plan, build and review one task. The plan stays in your repo.

shots.vo: In your repo, run specweave init. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.

showLines: ✓ 11 skills installed as sw-* in .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/
steps.elide: dim … row between and after the two lines

shots.vo: Sign OpenCode in to a model provider first: run opencode auth login in a terminal. Open SpecWithCode, then Settings, Providers. Click Add provider, pick OpenCode, click Next twice, then Add instance.
shots.stepChip: Settings → Providers → Add provider → OpenCode → Add instance

steps.name: Account: Demo Mac
steps.note: the sidebar footer; Settings is in this menu on 0.2.6

steps.name: Providers
steps.note: only Codex and Claude rows show; OpenCode is off by default

steps.text: Add an account or configure a provider
steps.note: dialog "Add provider", steps Provider, Identity, Config
Identity step: Label OpenCode, Instance ID opencode; left as is

steps.text: Leave blank to let SpecWithCode spawn the server when needed.
steps.note: Config step: Binary path, Server URL, Server password; all left empty
"Authenticated · OpenCode 2.0.26 lists N models." in the OpenCode panel

steps.name: Back
steps.note: settings sidebar footer; returns to the Overview (cut in the edit)

shots.vo: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick OpenCode in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.

steps.name: Add project
steps.note: the + next to Projects
"New project" and "Personal assistant" rows sit above it
adding the folder opens a new chat; no separate New chat click
the model picker is labelled with the current model; with only OpenCode ready it defaults to an OpenCode model (Big Pickle or Aion 3.5 in the takes)

steps.name: OpenCode
steps.note: the Providers rail; Codex and Claude are not signed in in the demo HOME

steps.name: Runtime mode
steps.note: defaults to Supervised

shots.vo: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. OpenCode writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
shots.stepChip: $ → Sw Increment → describe the change → Enter

steps.name: Message
steps.note: placeholder "Ask for changes, send follow-ups, or attach images" on a new chat
the menu lists OpenCode's own OpenCode and Report skills, then the 11 skills title-cased (Sw Auto … Sw Team), each tagged Provider Skill

steps.text: Personal greeting: greet(name) returns "Hello, <name>!" and greet() still returns "Hello, world!". Use Ada in examples. Plan only, no code yet.

steps.note: send button aria-label "Submit message"
speed-ramped in the edit, with the Sped up chip
hold on the reply: AC-01, AC-02, T-01 with its files and npm test

shots.vo: Then send sw-do. OpenCode claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
shots.stepChip: $ → Sw Do → claim → edit → test → done

steps.text: Do T-01, then stop. I will close the increment myself.

steps.note: expands the turn's steps
hold on: specweave task claim T-01, the edit to src/greeting.js, npm test and specweave task done … --run "npm test"

shots.vo: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

steps.note: on the last turn's "N changed files" card
the done line: "by":"opencode@demo" with its evidence

shots.vo: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.
